epa_notes: A family of 6 patients identified to have elevated serum concentrations of PFAAs, likely through repeated commercial spraying of their home carpets with stain-repellents. Patients were treated by intermittent phlebotomy over a 4-5 yr period. CAUTION: EPA's 'Number of Subjects' cell for this study holds '53 Father, 47 Mother, 22 first male child, 19 second female child, 17 third male child, 16 fourth male child' - these are AGES (consistent with the stated 16-53 y age range), not subject counts; the study has n=1 per listed individual, 6 total. Half-lives here are confounded by the phlebotomy intervention and are not background elimination.
